sections.Profile:
The "Race the Clock" pinball machine, launched by Williams Manufacturing Company on March 30, 1955, is notable as the company’s first four-player electro-mechanical game.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
sections.Editions: - Race the Clock: released 1955-03-01, model number 125
